notes.title: New-Offline income function/5 extended achievements

* Adjustment-after the statue is repaired, the profession bonus ratio is increased by 2 times
* Adjustment-the weapon tower is changed to 5% for each level of enhancement
* Adjustment-the critical damage range of the term is 1-500% not affected by the level, and the critical rate is 1-5%
* Adjustment-enhance all professional bonus terms
* Adjustment-reduce the drop rate of easter eggs
* Fix the problem that the mouse dragging occasionally gets stuck,
* Fixed the random value calculation problem of weapon tower enhancement
* Fixed the display problem caused by SS career attack/inheritance entry
* Fixed the display problem caused by assassin attack/life entry
* Fixed the text error of the quick smelting button in the smelting interface
* Fixed the problem that the slowdown effect of the easter egg boss always exists
* Fixed the problem of displaying the percentage of statue progress
* Fixed the problem that the smelting achievement was not triggered

notes.title: Major feature adjustments and updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329265/fd77ec8e0da849bd688363fefcb24d1a87154233.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329265/094c8459dc6a990f47d70fe6878047e1fbe66bd5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329265/0cc56706d14884e0336a46ce415ea711ea756e68.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329265/d52e2c3d41e59836ac590778eeaaef1709025e0e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329265/812cac3e5b138b61676232b12f77647832f76497.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329265/cb9c327541c045f5a608de1fa45bc45137fae879.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329265/3449cd8270b0e3af2ed1f169ebfc6dc04951ba45.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329265/f387e7bbcecac20dfb2257c1fa03c6586fa60031.jpg[/img]


[list]
[*]- Adjusted the roulette gameplay and added new content: including weapons, buffs, shards, adventurers, and special bosses such as **Golden Bear**, **Pink Slime**, **Cake Slime**, and **Cat Paw Monster**. The roulette now requires **Star Coins** to spin.  
[*] - Updated the crafting logic: crafting failures no longer give eggs but instead return 2 random materials.  
[*] - Removed the original shard shop. Shards are now categorized into **N/A/S-grade shards**, no longer tied to specific classes. They can be obtained from monster drops or the roulette.  
[*] - Rescuing NPCs now shows the corresponding unlocked features upon clicking. The menu bar has been streamlined, and a new dialogue feature has been added.  
[*]- Added three new **Sage Statues** (1, 2, and 3) for unlocking features.  
[*] - Introduced the **final boss**.  
[*] - Expanded crafting recipes with over 20 new options.  
[*]- Added a **custom floor AFK feature** for convenience.  
[*]- Reworked the **chef's shop buffs** into a task release system.  
[*]- The **mysterious figure** has been reworked to focus on potion crafting.  
[*]- Merchants now have an **equipment recycling** feature.  
[*]- Weapon tower enhancements are now divided into **attack-focused upgrades** and **production-focused upgrades**.  
[*]- Localization: **English language support** has been added.  
[*] - Adjusted in-game values and updated the rescue system logic.  
[*]- Optimized the **UI list** for better performance and usability.  
[*] - Fixed the issue where HP was incorrectly displayed as attack.  
[*]- **Mage/Archer attack damage** now displays decimal points.  
[*]- Fixed the issue where the **SS-class stealth skill** would not disappear properly.  
[*] - Adjusted boss drops and significantly increased material drop rates.  
[*] - Fixed various bugs.  
[/list]

notes.title: Numerical adjustment/bug fix
notes.content:
* Numerical display abbreviation
* Fixed the problem of calculation error of attack/life bonus entries and inconsistency in panel display
* Invisibility reduced to 6 seconds
*The number of Berserker targets increased to 2
*The number of targets in Thief's Mist has been reduced to 2
*The number of evil shaman targets increased to 2
* Meteoric Magister skill damage becomes 100%
* The self-destructing zombie skill changes to 7% of the target and 20% of the self
* The instructor skill drop rate decreases with the number of layers
* The SS career inheritance ratio calculation is changed to a single inheritance for each type instead of total value inheritance. The hp/atk calculation formula = sum of each type * ratio is no longer included in the number of captures.
* Weapon tower production time is 60 seconds
* xx professional attack/life bonus entry adjusted to 1-5%
* Shorten the build time and slightly increase the build cost
*Adjust the gain and change it to purchase with star coins
* If a duplicate formula is extracted from the turntable, a set of materials will be returned
*Monsters will activate damage reduction and life recovery as the level of difficulty increases.
